claim: The replatform strategy involves moving applications almost as-is, but replacing some components to take advantage of a cloud architecture, without changing the core architecture of the application; you may be looking only to reduce the amount of time that you spend managing your broker.

evidence.quote: The replatform strategy involves moving applications almost as-is, but replacing some components to take advantage of a cloud architecture. Here you might make a number of cloud-based optimizations to achieve some tangible benefit, but you aren't changing the core architecture of your application. You may be looking only to reduce the amount of time that you spend managing your broker.
